name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
description: An Echoverse Pia Nalaar who stands against the Consulate and tends a garden she hopes her daughter will one day enjoy.

relations.note: Pia raised Chandra apart from the Consulate.
relations.quote: Pia believed it was best to raise Chandra far from the Consulate's influence.
